overview:
The contract between the Jelly server and its clients, the desktop app and the stage page.

**Authentication:** A player sends `Authorization: Bearer <secret>`. A new secret only arrives from `POST /v1/auth/redeem` or `POST /v1/auth/recover`, and clients keep it to themselves. The stage page reads with the stage key in the query `key`, which allows reading only.

**Units:** All times are milliseconds since 1970 in server time. Use `server_time` from an answer for countdowns instead of the clock of the device. All positions on the stage are percent of the room. Distances in rules such as `near_distance` and `walk_speed` count jelly units: a jelly is about 1.7 wide, the hall 21 wide and 40 deep.

**Growth:** Answers can gain fields, event types, catalog entries, enum values and error codes in any version, so clients ignore what they do not know. Requests reject unknown fields. A breaking change gets a new path version.

**Errors:** Every error has the form `{"error":{"code","message"}}`. `code` is stable and meant for code, `message` is German and meant for people, so show it for unknown codes. `invalid_request` answers with 400 (no valid JSON), 408 or 413 (body too slow or too large), 415 (not JSON) or 422 (unknown or missing field, wrong type). After a network error, read `GET /v1/players/me` before repeating an action, because it may have counted already. `401` means the secret is no longer valid. Never delete a secret because of a network error.

operations.getCatalog: Works without an account. Clients read keys, names and labels from here instead of hard-coding them. Secret achievements are not listed.
operations.getMe: The main read of the app. Open the stream afterwards with `since` set to `last_event_id`, so nothing gets lost in between.
operations.updateMe: Missing fields stay unchanged, and an empty request changes nothing and sends no event. Can answer `invalid_name`, `invalid_color` and `name_taken`.
operations.getPlayer: Works for every player with an account. An unknown or removed player answers `404 player_not_found`.
operations.createReport: Earns XP within the rules of the LAN. Can answer `report_cooldown`, `report_limit`, `no_active_lan` and `not_joined`. After a report the jelly walks to a zone of kind `queue` for `snack_run_seconds`.
operations.redeemEventCode: Earns the XP of the code once per player. Can answer `invalid_event_code` and `event_code_redeemed`.
operations.playEmote: All screens hear about it through the event `emote`. Can answer `unknown_emote` and `emote_cooldown`.
operations.showSign: The sign stays up until it is lowered or replaced. Answers `unknown_sign` for a key that is not in the catalog.
operations.lowerSign: Lowering without a sign changes nothing.
operations.startStack: Everyone nearby can climb on it with `POST /v1/stacks/members`. It falls apart after `stack_seconds`. Starting a stack ends a trip or following.
operations.leaveStack: The jellies above slide down one level.
operations.listPartnerEmotes: Lets an app bring back its popups after a restart.
operations.getStage: Takes a player secret or the stage key. Afterwards open the stream with `since` set to `last_event_id`. `moves` holds the current walk of each jelly.
operations.endTrip: Ends a trip or following at once, and the jelly walks back to its place.

parameters.cursor: Where the page starts, the `next_cursor` of the page before. Empty for the first page.
parameters.limit: How many entries a page holds at most.
parameters.key: The stage key, for the stage page. Players send their secret as a bearer token instead.
parameters.since: The last event ID the client knows, usually `last_event_id` from a state it just read.
parameters.topics: Comma-separated list of `events` and `moves`. Without it, both arrive. Unknown topics answer `400 invalid_request`.
parameters.Last-Event-ID: Sent by the browser or the client when it reconnects, and takes priority over `since`.

fields.title: German title to show.
fields.description: German text that says how to earn it.
fields.scope: `permanent` stays across all LANs, `lan` can be earned again at each LAN.
fields.goal: How often the action has to happen until it is earned.
fields.record_unit: German unit of the personal record. With it, the achievement has one stage and then only tracks the best value.

ActionAnswer.description: The result of an action that can earn XP.

fields.xp_gained: XP this action earned. 0 is no error, for example after a poke that came too early.
fields.me: The state of the player after the action.

Badge.description: Shows that a player attended a LAN.

fields.slug: Stable short name of the LAN.
fields.name: Name of the LAN to show.

Catalog.description: The fixed lists of the server. Entries can be added in any version.

fields.cosmetics: All cosmetics. Some can only be given as an award.
fields.cosmetic_slots: The places on a jelly that can wear a cosmetic.
fields.cosmetic_colors: Hex colors that colorable cosmetics can take.
fields.achievements: All achievements that are not secret.

CatalogEntry.description: One choice of a fixed list.

fields.key: Stable key to send to the server.
fields.label: German text to show.

CodeBody.description: A request with one event code.

fields.code: The code as the player typed it.

Cosmetic.description: One item a jelly can wear.

fields.name: German name to show.
fields.scope: `permanent` counts progress over all LANs, `lan` only counts the current LAN.
fields.slot: The place on the jelly that wears it, one of `cosmetic_slots`.
fields.colorable: Whether it takes a color from `cosmetic_colors`. The others always look the same.
fields.unlock: How a player gets it: `level` from reaching `level`, `event` from an event code, `award` as a prize from the orga, `none` not at all. Treat new values like `none`.
fields.level: The level that unlocks it, only with `unlock` `level`.

EarnedAchievement.description: An achievement in the history of a player.

fields.key: Key of the achievement. Secret ones are not in the catalog, so show `title`.
fields.title: German title to show.
fields.lan_slug: The LAN it was earned at, or null for one that stays across LANs.
fields.best: The personal record, only for record achievements.
fields.record_unit: German unit of the record, only for record achievements.

fields.slot: The slot to change, one of `cosmetic_slots`.
fields.key: The cosmetic to put on, out of `cosmetics` in the state. Without it, the slot is emptied.
fields.color: Hex color from `cosmetic_colors`, only for colorable cosmetics.

EquippedCosmetic.description: What a jelly wears in one slot.

fields.color: The chosen hex color, null for cosmetics that are not colorable.

ErrorDetails.description: The content of an error answer.

fields.code: Stable code for programs. The overview of this document lists all codes.
fields.message: German text for people. Show it for codes the client does not know.

ErrorResponse.description: The form of every error answer.

Event.description: One entry of the event log. It holds IDs and keys, never names.

fields.id: Rising number of the event, the `since` of a later reconnect.
fields.type: What happened. The stream route lists all types, unknown ones are ignored.
fields.player_id: The player it is about, null for events of the whole stage.
fields.payload: Details that depend on `type`, see the stream route.

fields.player_id: The player to follow. Circles of followers answer `400 invalid_follow`.

Gathering.description: Sends all jellies of a LAN somewhere for a while, started by the orga. Nothing pauses: a trip, following or a stack runs on in the background and goes on afterwards if its time is not over yet.

fields.kind: `food` sends the jellies to the zones of kind `queue`. `ceremony` sends them to `spectators` and the winner to `winner`. Treat new values as nothing to show.
fields.winner_id: The winner of a ceremony, who grows on the stage. Null without one.
fields.ends_at: When it ends and the jellies walk back.

HighlightBody.description: Names the jelly to light up.

fields.player_id: The player to light up, which can be the own one.

fields.state: `accepted` or `declined` from the invited jelly, `cancelled` from the one who asked.

fields.key: The emote, out of `partner_emotes` in the catalog.
fields.partner_ids: The invited jellies, exactly one for now.

KeyBody.description: A request that names one entry of a fixed list.

LANInfo.description: The newest LAN of an account, which does not have to be the running one.

fields.slug: Stable short name of the LAN.
fields.name: Name of the LAN to show.
fields.active: Whether this LAN runs right now.

fields.slug: Stable short name of the LAN.
fields.name: Name of the LAN to show.

LANStatus.description: Which LAN runs and which comes next.

fields.server_time: The time of the server when it answered.
fields.joined: With a secret, whether this player takes part in the running LAN. Otherwise null.

Move.description: One walk of a jelly, planned by the server so all screens show the same. Between two points the jelly walks straight, after the last one it stands there. A newer move of the same jelly replaces this one and starts where the jelly is at its `start_at`.

fields.kind: Why it walks: `wander`, `follow`, `trip`, `snack`, `stack`, `food` or `ceremony`. Treat new values like `wander`.
fields.start_at: When the walk starts. New walks start about one second in the future, so they reach every screen in time.
fields.points: The way to walk. A single point means the jelly stands there.
fields.stack_level: How many jellies stand below this one, once it arrived at the last point. Above 0 only on a stack.

PartnerInvite.description: A request for a partner emote.

fields.id: Number of the invite, for answering it.
fields.key: The emote, out of `partner_emotes` in the catalog.

PartnerInviteList.description: The open partner emotes of the player.

fields.next_cursor: Always null for now, kept so this list can get pages later.

PartnerInviteResult.description: A partner emote after a change.

fields.partner_emote: The invite in its new state.
fields.xp_gained: XP this change earned. Both jellies earn once per partner and LAN, afterwards it is 0.
fields.me: The state of the player after the change.

PlayerAward.description: A prize in the history of a player, given by the orga.

fields.title: Free text of the orga.
fields.cosmetic_key: The cosmetic that came with it, or null.

PlayerList.description: One page of the player list.

fields.next_cursor: The `cursor` of the next page, null on the last page.

PlayerProfile.description: What every account can read about another player.

fields.name: The name of the jelly.
fields.color: The color of the jelly, out of `colors` in the catalog.
fields.equipped: What the jelly wears, by slot.
fields.xp: XP in the newest LAN of the player.
fields.level: Level in the newest LAN of the player.
fields.lans_attended: How many LANs the player was active at.
fields.badges: One badge for each attended LAN.

PlayerState.description: The state of the own player, the answer of most actions. Fields that only make sense during a LAN are null outside of one.

fields.server_time: The time of the server when it answered, for countdowns.
fields.last_event_id: Where to open the stream to miss nothing after this state.
fields.id: The number of the player. It can be known to others and opens nothing without the secret.
fields.name: The name of the jelly.
fields.color: The color of the jelly, out of `colors` in the catalog.
fields.equipped: What the jelly wears, by slot.
fields.hidden: Whether the orga hid this jelly from the stage.
fields.lan: The newest LAN of the account, which does not have to be the running one. Null without any. `GET /v1/lans/current` says whether one runs.
fields.next_poke_at: When the next poke can earn XP. Null outside an active LAN.
fields.reports: What the player can report now. Null outside an active LAN.
fields.sign: Key of the raised sign, or null.
fields.follow: The jelly this one follows, or null. The server can end following by itself, so always read it from here.
fields.lans_attended: How many LANs the player was active at.
fields.badges: One badge for each attended LAN.
fields.cosmetics: Keys of all cosmetics this player may wear.

ProfileBody.description: Changes the profile. Missing fields stay unchanged.

fields.name: The new name: 1 to 24 characters of Latin letters, umlauts, ß, digits, spaces and `. _ ' -`, at least one letter or digit. The prefix `Jelly-` is reserved.
fields.color: The new color, out of `colors` in the catalog.

PublicPlayer.description: One line of the player list.

fields.name: The name of the jelly.
fields.color: The color of the jelly, out of `colors` in the catalog.

fields.secret: The secret of the account: new for a new account, otherwise the one the caller sent. Keep it safe, it cannot be read again.
fields.seat_assigned: Whether the account got the seat of the code. False for the code of a LAN and when the seat was taken or the account already has one. Then the orga assigns a seat by hand.

RecoverAnswer.description: The account behind a recovery code.

fields.secret: The new secret of the account, the old one no longer works. Keep it safe, it cannot be read again.

RecoverBody.description: Exchanges a recovery code for a new secret.

fields.code: The recovery code from the orga.

RedeemBody.description: Brings an account into a LAN with a code.

fields.code: The seat code or the code of a LAN.
fields.name: The name of a new account, with the same rules as in `PATCH /v1/players/me`. Ignored with a secret.
fields.color: The color of a new account, out of `colors` in the catalog. Ignored with a secret.

RedeemedCode.description: The result of an event code.

fields.title: The title of the code, as the orga wrote it.
fields.me: The state of the player after the code.

ReportStatus.description: What a player can report right now.

fields.food_ready_at: When food can be reported again, 0 if nothing was reported yet.
fields.drink_ready_at: When a drink can be reported again, 0 if nothing was reported yet.
fields.reports_left: How many reports are left in the current time window of the LAN.

Room.description: What the coordinates of the stage mean.

fields.unit: The unit of all positions, `percent` for now.

Stack.description: A tower of jellies at one spot.

fields.id: Number of the stack, for climbing on it.
fields.x: Position of the stack in percent of the stage width.
fields.y: Position of the stack in percent of the stage height.
fields.member_ids: The jellies on it, from the bottom to the top.

fields.stack: The stack in its new form.
fields.me: The state of the player after the change.

StackMemberBody.description: Names the stack to climb on.

StageAnswer.description: Everything a stage or a map needs to start.

fields.last_event_id: Where to open the stream to miss nothing after this state.
fields.server_time: The time of the server when it answered. Moves are played against this clock.
fields.players: All jellies on the stage. Absent ones are not listed.
fields.gathering: What all jellies do right now, or null. It ends at `ends_at` without an event.
fields.moves: The current walk of each jelly. New ones arrive in the stream as `move`.

StageArea.description: One zone of the room, in percent of the stage. Zones can overlap. `x`, `y`, `width` and `height` say where it would stand without `rotation`.

fields.rotation: Degrees clockwise seen from above, from 0 up to below 360. The zone turns around its middle and keeps its size on the floor. Percent has a different length on each axis, so turn it on the floor and not in percent. At 0, the front of the model faces the camera, toward larger `y`.
fields.kind: How jellies use the zone. They belong to `seats`, `stage`, `lounge` and `visitors`, line up in `queue`, and `public` is a named place to go to. `spectators` and `winner` are for a ceremony, `none` is not assigned yet. Treat new values like `none`.
fields.blocks: Whether jellies walk around this zone. `POST /v1/trips/goto` refuses points in it.
fields.prop: The model that stands here, or empty for bare floor. Unknown props show bare floor.
fields.name: The name of a `public` zone to show, null for all other kinds.

StagePlayer.description: A jelly as the stage shows it.

fields.name: The name of the jelly.
fields.color: The color of the jelly, out of `colors` in the catalog.
fields.equipped: What the jelly wears, by slot.
fields.level: The level in the running LAN.
fields.sign: Key of the raised sign, or null.
fields.follow: The jelly this one follows, or null.
fields.area_id: The zone the jelly belongs to, or null.
fields.is_visitor: A jelly without a place of its own wanders through the zones of kind `visitors`.
fields.home_x: The place of the jelly in percent of the stage width. Where it is right now comes from `moves`.
fields.home_y: The place of the jelly in percent of the stage height. Where it is right now comes from `moves`.

StagePoint.description: A point on the stage, for example the goal of a trip. A point outside or in a zone with `blocks` answers `400 invalid_trip`.

Trip.description: A running walk to a point on the stage.

fields.x: The goal in percent of the stage width.
fields.y: The goal in percent of the stage height.
fields.ends_at: When the jelly walks back to its place.

VersionInfo.description: Tells an app whether it can still talk to this server.

fields.api_version: The version of this API, in the form `1.2.3`.
fields.min_client_version: The oldest app that still works, in the form `1.2.3`. Empty means no minimum.

fields.t: Milliseconds after `start_at` when the jelly reaches this point.

events.meaning: A jelly came to the stage.
A jelly changed.
events.payload: `{}`, or `{"edited":true}` if the player changed it

events.meaning: The orga hid a jelly.
An account was deleted.
A player earned XP. `source` is `poke`, `food`, `drink`, `event` or `partner`.
A player reached a new level.
A player earned an achievement.
The orga gave a prize. `title` is free text.
A jelly plays an emote.
Two jellies play a partner emote. The event names who accepted and who asked. Without an event, one of them is hidden.
A partner emote was created or changed. The app of an invited jelly finds itself in `partner_ids` and shows its popup.
A jelly raised or lowered a sign.
A jelly started following, or ended following or a trip.
A jelly started a trip.
A stack was started or changed.
events.payload: The stack, only `{"id"}` after climbing down

events.meaning: A jelly lights up so it can be found. It shows the aura `cosmetic_key` instead of its own one until `ends_at`.
The room changed, so read `GET /v1/stage` again.
A gathering started or was ended early. A normal end sends nothing, so use `ends_at`.
events.payload: The `Gathering`, null after an early end

events.meaning: A jelly starts a walk. This message has no ID and is not part of the event log.
events.payload: The data is a whole `Move`, not an `Event`

events.meaning: The stream dropped events for this client, so read the state again.
